name: Avg Other IO Operations (per Second) per Process and Host

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Windows/OS/Windows "Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfProc_Process" !"_Total" "IOOtherOperationsPersec" 
| parse regex "winbox = (?<dest_host>\S+)" nodrop 
| if (isNull(dest_host) or dest_host="",_sourceHost,dest_host) as host
| kv regex "= (?:\"|)(.*?)(?:\"|);" keys "IOOtherOperationsPersec","Name" as ioOthers,procName | where procName != "_Total"
| avg(ioOthers) as AvgIOOther by host, procName
| transpose row host column procName
